sec.title: August 30 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 417)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 30** across American network radio and country variety syndication, Orson Welles starring in Herman Melville's *Moby Dick* on *The Mercury Summer Theatre of the Air* for Pabst Blue Ribbon (1946), Barton Yarborough and Barney Phillips in *The Rodeo at Silver Bow* on *Hawk Larabee* (1947), Red Foley with three country sessions on *The Tide Show* (1945–1951), and Myrtle Vail's backstage classic *Myrt and Marge* (1945–1951):
